transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I came in because I just barely sleep right anymore. I'll lie there at night... hearing rain, or just thinking about the bluff giving way. And then when I finally do manage to pass out, I wake up all sweaty from these dreams. By the time I show up for my shift at the call center, I feel like I never even went to sleep.
Could you tell me a little more about the 'bluff giving way' that you mentioned?

Yeah, um... about four months ago, I was out on this bluff trail and the ground just gave way. It completely collapsed, and I actually got trapped out there. So, that's what I meant. All this stuff with my sleep... it's been going on ever since that happened. So, for about four months now.
Since that day, do you find yourself going out of your way to avoid places or situations that remind you of the bluff collapse?

Yeah, I do. I mean, I won't go anywhere near the coast trails now. And... I've actually been dodging texts from my hiking buddies, too. They keep reaching out, but honestly, even just talking about going out there makes my chest tighten up. So I just stay away from all of it.
